metadata.title: Mid-Century Minimalist Line Art Album Cover
useCases: Vintage jazz or soul album art

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist ink-line portrait paired with a right-aligned vertical stack of high-contrast geometric color blocks containing bold sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark white composition featuring a delicate, continuous-style black ink line drawing of a face on the left, balanced by a rigid, rectangular stack of orange and yellow blocks on the upper right containing heavy black lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic hand-drawn lines versus rigid geometric blocks
Expansive white negative space versus dense color saturation
Asymmetrical balance between the large portrait and the compact text block
coreInvariants: Fine-gauge black ink line work for the portrait
Stacked rectangular color fields in the upper right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale line art portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant orange and yellow rectangular block in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text block, moves down through the color fields, then sweeps left across the minimalist facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white background providing breathing room for the thin line work.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange and Lemon Yellow (geometric blocks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the small geometric area against a zero-saturation white field.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, mid-century industrial feel of the display text.
Provides the geometric purity seen in the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist black ink line drawing of a woman's face on a plain white background, positioned to the left. Leave the top right quadrant empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of three rectangular blocks (orange, orange-to-black gradient, yellow) in the top right. Place bold black uppercase sans-serif text inside the orange and yellow blocks.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered in thin black lines only?
Are the color blocks strictly rectangular and right-aligned?
Is the typography bold, black, and sans-serif?
Is there significant white space on the left and bottom?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues

avoid: Shading or gradients in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the line art does not overlap the color blocks.
Verify the text is legible against the orange and yellow backgrounds.
Check that the overall composition maintains an asymmetrical balance.
Confirm the background is a clean, solid white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Line Portrait + Right-Aligned Geometric Text Block = Mid-Century Modern Aesthetic
